phrases.local: すみません、食券の買い方を教えてください。
phrases.romanization: Sumimasen, shokken no kaikata o oshiete kudasai.
phrases.gloss: Excuse me, could you show me how to buy a meal ticket?
phrases.because: You order from a ticket machine here

phrases.local: ピーナッツアレルギーがあります。これに入っていますか？
phrases.romanization: Pīnattsu arerugī ga arimasu. Kore ni haitte imasu ka?
phrases.gloss: I have a peanut allergy. Is there any in this?

phrases.local: 一番人気はどれですか？
phrases.romanization: Ichiban ninki wa dore desu ka?
phrases.gloss: Which one is the most popular?
phrases.because: You'd rather have the local favourite

tips.text: Buy a ticket at the machine by the door and hand it to the staff. Many machines take cash only, so keep a few ¥1,000 notes.
No tipping, unlike Canada, and slurping your noodles is perfectly normal.
